ModMetaData.name: ProjectZ ladder test Defs
ModMetaData.author: Lin
ModMetaData.description: Test Defs for ProjectZ mode customladders. A template: it ships inside ProjectZ's Source/Dev but is never loaded from there (RimWorld loads only mods directly in its Mods folder). For a test run: Source/Dev/testmods.sh install ladders, then remove ladders.
